notes.title: Sanguo Warriors VR2 Updated Version
notes.notes:
1.All new Stage: Snow Mountain
In the new stage, players will have a new blade that could be thrown. Player can find the new blade in the chest which locates at the starting place of Snow Mountain Stage. 
New magic ability: Fireball Spell. To obtain the magic ability, players need to trigger the plot and search within the specific area. 
New enemies: assassins and axes that will show up in the new stage. 
New boss: Jia Xu
2.Performance improvements. 
Players can now choose stage at the sandbox map. Improving the performance of things grabbing, User Interface, interactive feedback, and weapon discard. Adding bunch of interactive objects and all new user guide. 
3. Bow weapon improvements. 
Improving the direct damage of Triple arrows attack and adding the fire effect with DOT. 
4.AI system improvements. 
AI will have better performance at navigation and behavior. 
5.Enemies Ability Improvements
The soldier with shield is stronger than before and has new attack mode. 
The ice skeleton boss is more powerful to fit the battle experience. 
6.  Critical Bug fixes. 
Fixed AI movement error.
Fixed AI pathfinding error. 
Fixed AI physical performance error.
